steps.comment: Task 1: upload a (fictional) weekly report to Drive
steps.show: gwscli drive create_file --title "AIQuest gwscli demo - weekly report" --filePath data/aiquest-gwscli-demo-report.md --contentMimeType text/markdown

Usage:
  gwscli drive [command]

Available Commands:
  copy_file             Call this tool to copy an existing File in Google Drive.
  create_file           Call this tool to create or upload a File to Google Drive.
  download_file_content Call this tool to download the content of a Drive file as a base64 encoded string.
  get_file_metadata     Call this tool to find general metadata about a user's Drive file.
  get_file_permissions  Call this tool to list the permissions of a Drive File.
  list_recent_files     Call this tool to find recent files for a user specified a sort order. Default sort order is `recency` if orderBy is not set or set to an unsupported value.
  read_file_content     Call this tool to fetch a natural language representation of a known Drive file, and if specified, its comments.
  search_files          Search for Drive files using a structured query (syntax: `query_term operator values`). Only terms in this list are supported.
  upload_file_revision  Call this tool to upload a new content revision for an existing blob file in Google Drive.

Global Flags:
  -h, --help                 Print help message
      --oauth_token string   OAuth token to authenticate requests directly

Use "gwscli drive [command] --help" for more information about a command.

steps.comment: Find it again with a structured Drive query
steps.show: gwscli drive search_files --query "title contains 'AIQuest gwscli demo'" --excludeContentSnippets

steps.comment: Task 2: book a review meeting on my calendar
steps.show: gwscli calendar create_event --summary "AIQuest demo: review gwscli report" --startTime 2026-11-26T10:00:00 --endTime 2026-11-26T10:30:00

steps.comment: Read the calendar back (only demo events)

steps.show: gwscli tasks create_task --title "AIQuest demo: send weekly report" --scheduledDate 2026-11-26

steps.comment: Task 4: draft (not send) the status e-mail
steps.show: gwscli gmail create_draft --to demo@example.com --subject "AIQuest demo: weekly report" --body "..."
